title: The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book 2, Fugue 24 in B minor

character.text: Light galant passepied, without learned devices

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From B minor to F♯ minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times).
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to D major

sections.label: Episode 3
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted and a figure from the subject. Alto: a figure from the subject. Bass: free counterpoint.
sections.leads: From D major to A major

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted. Returns in Episode 7 (bars 87–99).
sections.leads: From A major to F♯ minor

sections.label: Episode 5
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times) and a figure from the subject. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From F♯ minor to B minor

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B minor, rhythm varied (Alto); Subject in E minor, rhythm varied (Bass)
Episode 6
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times). Alto: free counterpoint. Bass: a figure from the subject (2 times) and a figure from the subject, inverted.
sections.leads: From E minor to B minor

sections.label: Episode 7
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 4 (bars 50–54), in the same voices, a fourth higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times) and the opening of the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject (6 times) and the opening of countersubject 1 (2 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: Perfect cadence in B minor at bar 100

spans.label: Codetta
spans.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (4 times). Alto: a figure from the subject.
